entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes. I think I need to make a return. I'm a bit confused about the process. It's about some shoes.
I can certainly help you with that. To start, could you please provide your full name and order number?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is... uh, hold on... VF-881-2945.
Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the VeloFit Pro-Ride cycling shoes. What specifically is the issue with them?
I'm just so overwhelmed. I tried to set them up, but the cleats were so complicated. I took them for one ride and they gave me terrible blisters. I don't think they're for me.
I'm very sorry to hear about the blisters, that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I'm just pulling up the delivery date here... I see they were delivered to you 70 days ago.
Oh, has it been that long? I wasn't sure if I could still... The website was a bit hard to understand. Can't you just help me? I just want to send them back.
Of course, I can help. Let me just confirm our policy. Yes, for our standard items like those cycling shoes, we have a 90-day return window. Since you're at day 70, you are well within that period.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. So I can get a refund?

Absolutely. You are eligible for a full refund. I can start that process for you right now and email you a pre-paid return shipping label. Once we receive the shoes, we'll process the refund back to your original payment method.
That is such a relief! Thank you so much, Alex. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome, Sarah. The email with the label is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
